description: The bar chart illustrates the number of datasets per year for the paper “The Unseen Targets of Hate — A Systematic Review of Hateful Communication Datasets,” separated by data source categories shown in the legend. The horizontal axis lists years from 2012 through 2022 in chronological order and is labeled “Year,” while the vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at regular 20-unit intervals (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100), extending slightly above 100 to accommodate the tallest bar. For each year, multiple adjacent (grouped) bars appear: a blue bar for data source “1,” an orange bar for a second data source, and in 2022 additional light-colored bars (light blue and light orange) appear as separate grouped categories. Approximate values by year are: 2012 shows a small orange bar around 2; 2013 shows a small blue bar around 2; 2014 shows a small blue bar around 3; 2015 shows a small orange bar around 2; 2016 shows blue around 10 and orange around 3; 2017 shows blue around 22 and orange around 6; 2018 shows blue around 30 and orange around 18; 2019 shows blue around 46 and orange around 19; 2020 shows blue around 87 and orange around 43; 2021 shows blue around 112 and orange around 47; and 2022 shows a light blue bar around 30 and a light orange bar around 7 (with no visible blue/orange bars for that year). The bars are not sorted by height; they follow the year order, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond their distinct colors and the legend.
